authoritative_subject_resolution: Resolve rider/student, lesson/training record, and barn to canonical records
per_subject_guardian_coverage: One qualifying guardian for the affected minor
consent_requirement: Current waiver and event approval when action requires them
consent_scope_reference: lesson_id or training enrollment plus policy/version
server_enforcement_point: Before readiness, enrollment, scheduling, signup, or participant write
atomicity_or_revalidation_requirement: Guard decision and write share transaction/conditional version or commit-time revalidation
required_failure_modes: Unknown age; missing guardian; invalid lifecycle; cross-barn; restricted authority; missing/stale consent
public_error_behavior: Disclosure-safe STUDENT_WORKFLOW_BLOCKED unless caller may see remediation detail
required_positive_behavior: Adult remains allowed; minor with current authority and required consent proceeds
closure_evidence: Route inventory; negative/positive API tests; birthday and concurrent revocation tests; UI/API evidence

authoritative_subject_resolution: Resolve all actual participants, recipients, linked student profiles, thread, and barn
per_subject_guardian_coverage: At least one access-capable qualifying guardian for each minor
consent_requirement: No separate consent unless an approved policy explicitly requires it
server_enforcement_point: Before thread creation, participant mutation, and every new message
atomicity_or_revalidation_requirement: Thread membership and send use conditional version/revalidation against relationship versions
required_failure_modes: Metadata omitted; private adult-minor thread; incomplete per-minor coverage; last guardian removal; revoked/expired/restricted guardian
public_error_behavior: Generic communication blocked response; precise internal reason retained
required_positive_behavior: Guardian-inclusive conversation for every minor and unrelated adult conversation remain allowed
closure_evidence: Thread/message tests; multi-minor tests; removal/revocation races; alternate sink review

consent_scope_reference: waiver_or_policy_id plus version and applicable lesson/event scope
server_enforcement_point: Before acceptance or waiver-dependent state transition
atomicity_or_revalidation_requirement: Consent/version and protected transition share conditional version/revalidation
required_failure_modes: Guardian link only; wrong guardian; wrong scope; stale version; revoked/expired consent; cross-barn

authoritative_subject_resolution: Resolve student, guardian signer, document request/envelope, version, and barn
consent_scope_reference: document_request_id or envelope_id plus document version
server_enforcement_point: Before signature request acceptance, signature status transition, or minor-bound document completion

authoritative_subject_resolution: Resolve student, media subject/use, release version, and barn
consent_scope_reference: media_use_id or purpose plus release version
server_enforcement_point: Before grant and before new media-use/publication state under repository control
atomicity_or_revalidation_requirement: Use transition revalidates current media consent/version

authoritative_subject_resolution: Resolve student, payer, invoice/obligation, amount, and barn
consent_requirement: Exact approved billing authorization where repository governance requires it
consent_scope_reference: invoice_or_obligation_id plus payer assignment and amount/range
server_enforcement_point: Before minor creates/accepts obligation or payer assignment
atomicity_or_revalidation_requirement: Conditional write/revalidation against guardian and billing authority versions

authoritative_subject_resolution: Resolve student, event, waivers, and barn
consent_requirement: Event-specific approval and current waiver where required
atomicity_or_revalidation_requirement: Registration conditioned on current event/waiver/guardian versions
required_failure_modes: No guardian; no event approval; stale waiver; cross-barn event; scope mismatch
required_positive_behavior: Current guardian approval allows the exact event signup
closure_evidence: Event route tests; version/scope evidence; revocation test

authoritative_subject_resolution: Resolve relationship, authority scopes, student, thread, and barn
per_subject_guardian_coverage: Per-minor coverage maintained for active conversations; relationship revocation itself remains lawful
guardian_authority_scope: RELATIONSHIP_ADMINISTRATION for grants/replacements; authorized revoker for revoke/suspend
consent_requirement: Reevaluate dependent consents/access after lifecycle change
server_enforcement_point: Before grant/activate/replace/revoke/suspend or participant mutation becomes effective
atomicity_or_revalidation_requirement: Atomic replacement or blocked interim state; versioned relationship transition; thread mutation conditional on current membership
required_failure_modes: Unauthorized grant; stale transition; disputed treated active; revocation blocked solely for no replacement; last guardian participant removed
public_error_behavior: Generic relationship action result where detailed state is not authorized
required_positive_behavior: Lawful revocation/suspension succeeds and blocks workflows; valid atomic replacement remains available
closure_evidence: Lifecycle tests; thread re-evaluation; concurrency tests; audit records
